summary: Multiple hub instances with file storage need shared NFS storage: set hub_shared_data_path=host:dir, and optionally hub_shared_data_mount_opts (default rw,sync,hard).
questions: How do I configure NFS for automation hub?
Do I need shared storage for multiple hub nodes?
What are the default hub NFS mount options?

answer_card.title: Hub on NFS
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
hub_shared_data_path=nfs-server.example.com:/exports/hub
hub_shared_data_mount_opts=rw,sync,hard   # default
```
Required for more than one hub instance with `file` storage.
